question: Hemolytic disease of the newborn, also called fetal eritoblastosis, can occur in women:

options.opa: Rh positive who have had an Rh positive child.
options.opb: Rh negative ones who have had an Rh positive child.
options.opc: Rh positive who have had a Rh negative child.
options.opd: Rh negative who have had a Rh negative child.
